    res=apis.venmo.search_friends(access_token=venmo_token, query='', page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not res:
        break
    venmo_friends_after.extend(res)
    page_index+=1

phone_friend_emails=set([c.get('email') for c in phone_friends if c.get('email')])
venmo_friend_emails_after=set([f.get('email') for f in venmo_friends_after if f.get('email')])
